title: Stellar Stroop Calculation
description: Calculate stroop unit conversions required for precision Soroban contract payments.

content.prompt: 1 XLM equals 10,000,000 (10^7) stroops. If a smart contract invocation consumes 2,500,000 stroops in resource fees, how many XLM was spent? (Enter the decimal number).
